thread.title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Stock Rating Upgraded by Vetr

author: Rob Logan
title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Stock Rating Upgraded by Vetr
text:
Posted by Rob Logan on Apr 17th, 2018 // No Comments 
Vetr upgraded shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from a buy rating to a strong-buy rating in a research note released on Friday, March 23rd. Vetr currently has $191.57 price objective on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
Several other equities analysts have also commented on AAPL. Nomura set a $185.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a research report on Monday, November 27th. UBS set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a report on Monday, November 27th. Tigress Financial reiterated a strong-buy rating on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 6th. KeyCorp reiterated a buy rating and set a $192.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. Finally, Stifel Nicolaus reissued a sell rating and set a $26.00 target price (up previously from $22.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 13th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of Buy and an average target price of $203.21. 
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL traded up $2.42 during midday trading on Friday, reaching $178.24. The stock had a trading volume of 26,594,249 shares, compared to its average volume of 36,156,457. The stock has a market cap of $886,582.31, a PE ratio of 19.35, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.25. Apple has a 12-month low of $140.45 and a 12-month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period last year, the company posted $3.36 earnings per share. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. research analysts expect that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year. 
In related news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the stock in a transaction on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,261,203.50. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . Also, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the stock in a transaction on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,194,221.92. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last ninety days, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
Several hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of AAPL. ADAMCAPITAL Gestao de Recursos Ltda. purchased a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter worth about $127,691,000. Chemical Bank increased its position in Apple by 0.3% during the 4th quarter. Chemical Bank now owns 92,548 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $15,662,000 after purchasing an additional 299 shares in the last quarter. Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. increased its position in Apple by 1.5% during the 4th quarter. Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. now owns 942,286 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $159,463,000 after purchasing an additional 13,995 shares in the last quarter. PHH Investments Ltd. grew its holdings in Apple by 5.9% in the 4th quarter. PHH Investments Ltd. now owns 10,218 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,729,000 after buying an additional 572 shares during the period. Finally, Certified Advisory Corp purchased a new stake in Apple in the 4th quarter valued at about $3,158,000. 61.35% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
